evidence.detail: get_locale() reads ?locale= from querystring and stores it in session — the original reported behavior is still present
Don't show language switcher to logged out users — reduces attack surface but does not fix locale persistence via querystring
Comment from bakert: translations broken since server migration, path forward may be to scrap i18n entirely rather than fix querystring persistence

triage.notes: Two possible resolutions: (a) remove the session write from get_locale() so querystring locale is ephemeral, or (b) remove i18n entirely. The owner comment strongly hints at (b). Either path is owner-decision territory.
